body: CI is manual-dispatch only; the local gate is task check (needs mockapi up via task mockapi:run / runbay session 'gqlkit mockapi'): lint (gofmt -l + golangci-lint uncapped on every go.work module), GOWORK=off go test -race -cover for gqlkit and gqlkit-sdl, mockapi -race, gqlkit-ts typecheck + npm test, docs:check, examples:test. mockapi:generate is pinned to GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.25.5 because gqlgen breaks under Go 1.27.
